title: Exact polynomial-time language for 3-CNF with few ternary clauses
claims: ExactLogarithmicThreeClauseSAT checks P membership for the exact reference-encoded language of satisfiable 3-CNF instances meeting the polynomial branching budget.
MeasuredWidthThree recognizes canonical 3-CNF encodings including empty clauses.
MeasuredRecordCount computes an exact unary count of nested records.
UnaryPowerBudget checks a power-of-two threshold by measured repeated halving.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
